title: Ingredients for robotics research
summary: We’re releasing eight simulated robotics environments and a Baselines implementation of Hindsight Experience Replay, all developed for our research over the past year. We’ve used these environments to train models which work on physical robots. We’re also releasing a set of requests for robotics research.
body: We’re releasing eight simulated robotics environments and a Baselines implementation of Hindsight Experience Replay, all developed for our research over the past year. We’ve used these environments to train models which work on physical robots. We’re also releasing a set of requests for robotics research.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了八个模拟机器人环境，并开源了Hindsight Experience Replay（HER）的Baselines实现。这些工具旨在支持机器人研究，通过仿真环境训练模型，并验证其在物理机器人上的迁移效果。此次发布还包含了一系列机器人研究需求，旨在推动该领域的标准化与技术进步。

aiReview.reasonZh: 发布了机器人仿真环境及相关算法实现，对机器人学习领域有直接推动作用。

glossary.explanationZh: 仿真环境，用于在虚拟空间中训练机器人模型。
一种强化学习技术，通过重放失败经验来学习目标达成。
OpenAI提供的强化学习算法库，包含多种标准算法实现。
机器人研究，涉及将AI模型应用于物理实体控制。
